name: Traffic
description: The ETT (Electricity Transformer Temperature) benchmark for multivariate time-series forecasting, containing hourly subsets ETTh1 and ETTh2 and 15-minute subsets ETTm1 and ETTm2. The Traffic dataset records hourly road occupancy rates from the San Francisco Bay area, used for multivariate forecasting benchmarks.
citation: Zhou, H., Zhang, S., Peng, J., Zhang, S., Li, J., Xiong, H., & Zhang, W. (2021). Informer: Beyond Efficient Transformer for Long Sequence Time-Series Forecasting. Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence, 35(12), 11106–11115. https://doi.org/10.1609/aaai.v35i12.17325
